name: HCM — Scenario 1: The Siding Reminder
description: Every Monday at 8:00 AM, count files in 00 THE SIDING. If > 0, send a Discord alert.

parameters.content: 🚦 Siding check: {{3.fileCount}} files need filing in 00 THE SIDING. Run your 10-minute Signal Check.

setup_notes.step_1: In Make.com, create a new scenario and import this blueprint using Scenario > Import Blueprint.
setup_notes.step_2: Replace PASTE_SIDING_FOLDER_ID_HERE with the Google Drive folder ID for '00 THE SIDING'. Find it in folder-id-map.json (key: 'siding') after running phase1-create-folders.js.
setup_notes.step_3: Replace PASTE_DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL_HERE with your Discord webhook URL. Create one in Discord: Server Settings > Integrations > Webhooks.
setup_notes.step_4: Set the Google Drive module to use your connected Google account.
setup_notes.step_5: Run the scenario once manually to test. Verify a Discord message appears if there are files in the Siding.
setup_notes.test_instructions: Drop one file into '00 THE SIDING' in Drive, then click 'Run once' in Make.com. You should see the Discord alert. Delete the test file after confirming.
